notes:
### 1. What the Product Does
MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping platform and API that unifies headless browser rendering, residential proxy rotation, anti-bot handling, and structured data extraction via natural language prompts. It supports both prompt-based AI scraping and manual step-based scraping.
* **Source:** `https://request.composio.dev/boards/tool-requests/posts/mrscraper`
  * **Quote:** `"mrscraper is an ai-powered web scraping toolkit for extracting structured data, rendered html, screenshots, and reusable scrape results from websites. it supports both prompt-based ai scraping and manual step-based scraping"`
* **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"MrScraper unifies headless browser rendering, residential proxy rotation, anti-bot handling, and AI prompt extraction into managed cloud endpoints."`

### 2. Every Auth Method & Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration
The public API relies exclusively on a static API token passed via a custom HTTP header. No OAuth2 or Basic authentication options are documented.
* **Auth Method:** Static API Token passed in the `x-api-token` header.
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"All API endpoints require authentication using an API token passed in the x-api-token header."`
* **Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration:** `bearer_token` (per the strict definition for static personal/access tokens not explicitly named "API key").

### 3. How to Get Credentials & Cost
Developers can obtain credentials instantly by signing up for an account on the MrScraper dashboard.
* **Access Type:** `self_serve_free`
* **Cost:** MrScraper offers a permanent free tier ("Scraper Free") providing 1,000 tokens per month without requiring a credit card. Paid plans start at $199/month for the "Scraper Pro" tier.
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"Plans include 1,000 Plan Tokens/month on Scraper Free ($0/mo, no credit card required) and 200,000 Plan Tokens/month on Scraper Pro ($199/mo), with flat $0.001/token overages."`

### 4. API Style, Breadth, OpenAPI Spec, Webhooks, Sandbox
* **API Style:** REST
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes."`
* **Breadth:** The API provides endpoints for managing and executing scrapers programmatically (Platform API), alongside direct utility endpoints like Web Unblocker, Scrape Markdown, Get Screenshot, Scrape JSON, Listing Page, and Scrape Sitemap.
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"Playground. Web Unblocker GET Scrape Markdown POST Get Screenshot POST Scrape JSON POST Listing Page POST Scrape Sitemap POST. Platform. Authentication. Scraper. Result. Analytic."`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** No official OpenAPI specification file or download link is provided in the public documentation.
* **Webhooks:** Supported. MrScraper can be configured to send real-time scraping results directly to external URLs.
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"MrScraper, for example, can be configured to deliver extracted data to a webhook endpoint — your..."`
* **Sandbox:** No separate sandbox environment is available; testing is conducted directly on the live platform using the free tier token allocation.

### 5. MCP Servers
* **MCP Type:** `official`
* **Details:** MrScraper officially supports the Model Context Protocol, providing an official MCP server with source code hosted on GitHub.
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"In addition to raw HTML and JSON, MrScraper provides native AI prompt extraction and an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server."`
  * **Source:** `https://mrscraper.com/blog/best-web-scraping-api`
  * **Quote:** `"The MrScraper MCP server source code is available on GitHub for local setup, contributions, and issue reports."`

### 6. Buildability Verdict & Main Blocker
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. The platform provides comprehensive public documentation and a self-serve free tier that allows immediate acquisition of working API credentials.
